abstract:
This paper presents a scalable, nonparametric approach to estimating point-wise price elasticities designed for real-time pricing decisions. A key challenge in these settings is correcting for price endogeneity while remaining computationally efficient. We address this by leveraging nonparametric control functions to decompose the identification of causal elasticities into a sequence of scalable intermediate prediction tasks. We implement this framework with bootstrap averaged (bagged) nearest neighbors, which admits a closed-form representation that enables scalable, real-time implementation. We establish uniform consistency of our estimator and show in Monte Carlo simulations that it robustly recovers local elasticities across a diverse range of data-generating processes. We demonstrate the method’s practical usefulness by applying it to the New York City ride-sharing market, recovering substantial spatial-temporal heterogeneity in price elasticity and updating citywide elasticity estimates in less than one minute, which provide a “just-in-time” input for algorithmic pricing systems.
                  This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.

ob.tldr: 提出可扩展的非参数即时价格弹性估计法，以非参数控制函数将因果识别分解为可扩展预测任务，并用装袋近邻实现快速估计。理论证明估计量一致，模拟显示其可稳健恢复局部弹性；纽约网约车应用可在不足一分钟内更新全市估计，揭示显著时空异质性并支持实时算法定价。

title: Scalable Just-in-Time Price Elasticity Estimation
title_zh: 可扩展的即时价格弹性估计
